★ Request
Dantsu reaches out her hand toward the Trainer.

A legal drama about a prosecutor my parents were obsessed with when I was little.
Back then, I couldn't understand it, but reaching this age, I've finally come to appreciate its appeal.

I let my thoughts drift to the scenery she told me about.
A gentle summer breeze suddenly caressed my cheek.

...Trainer.
If you'd like... I'd love to do something like today again.

D-Do you think so~? But... I'd be so happy if that were true!
Maybe that little penguin is also...? Just a thought, fufu.

Just watching them feels so soothing~.
...Ah! Look, the little penguin is waddling right over this way!
So many of them gathered that it got a little overwhelming, but... ahaha...

Waah, there really are so many things to see...! Where should we start?
Wherever you want to go, Trainer, anywhere at all—

! R-Really? Ehehe...
Ah, but... come to think of it—

(I wonder if someday... the warmth will feel different?
If that day ever comes—)
Maybe you'll feel that way about me too, Trainer—

(Your hand feels so warm and gentle today, too.
Just like the time we shook hands before.)
...Heeey, little penguins~! We'll come visit you again~!

...No. Since we're here today,
why don't we go to the places both of us want to visit?

We walked so much and talked about so many things today. I even learned
what your favorite drama is, Trainer... I had so much fun!

Flapping its little wings like that...
Could it be waving at us?

U-Um... I'm having trouble deciding on a color...
If it's okay with you! Trainer... would you pick one for me?
Fufu! ...Ah, that reminds me!

I went to a dog cafe once... and so many pups
gathered around me, it was so adorable!

On our day off at the end of summer training camp, Dantsu Flame and I came to a certain town.
It was packed with all sorts of attractions, from museums and art galleries to a zoo.

Hmm. But since it's a fireworks festival, maybe something a bit more vibrant...
I know! If we pick an obi with a bolder pattern—pardon me for a moment.
Yes...! In that case—!

...Um, what kind of scenes do you like in that show?
If you don't mind, I'd love to hear all about it.
How... does it look?

...
Um, Trainer. I—
(BOOM! KA-BOOM!)
(I hope I can keep getting to know you like this back then, too. ...I really do.)

The things I love. The things you love.
I want us to share lots of them together—

Yes! Just loafing around while eating their food,
or staring right at me with those round little eyes...

Is that so...!
Um, what kind of drama is it?

I thought I got to know you pretty well today, Trainer,
but it feels like there's still so much more—

Ohh, a legal drama about prosecutors...!
Fufu, somehow that sounds just like you, Trainer.

More and more.
I want to get to know you... and I want you to know me, too.

! I'm so glad.
I had a wonderful time too, visiting so many places with you.

We walked a lot today, so...
let's take it easy and just enjoy the fireworks for the rest of the night.

...
...Trainer. Um, how was today for you?

Yes! I always picture prosecutors as people driven by their convictions!
So it makes total sense that you'd like something like that, Trainer.
Fufu, so this is where you wanted to go, Trainer.

Trainer... do you have time tonight?
There's a fireworks festival near here. If you'd like...

Not at all! —Um... Trainer!
There's a yukata design I've had my eye on, too—

I recalled her reaching out her hand just like this when we first formed our contract.
Feeling a wave of nostalgia, I reached out my hand in return.

No, no, don't worry about that at all!
...You had such a wonderful expression on your face. One I'd never seen before.

Waaah, what a lovely cafe...!
The sunlight is gorgeous, and sitting on the terrace looks so nice!
Whoa~! There are elephants, bears, and even otters~!

Wah! Fireworks~~!! Hey, what do you think?
It's so easy to see from here, and it makes them look even more beautiful...!
...Fufu. So that's the look you make when you watch fireworks, Trainer.

Both dressed in yukatas, we made our way to the fireworks venue.
And the place we arrived at was—

! Wah, it looks great! It's mature and gentle, but
tightened up so smartly... It suits you perfectly, Trainer!
...Ah, yes! —Ehehe.

Tadaaa! It's a secret spot. I actually found it last year...
There's nobody around, and the view is amazing!

Wah! Trainer, that yukata looks so good on you!
The calm, mature color scheme really suits you...

We're back~! Whew, we've pretty much covered the whole area, haven't we?
...Time really flew by.
